title: THE LONG WAY BACK · XXI · The town, again
venue: the sabbatical · never posted · found in Box 9
logline: Stop twenty-one: Small Wood from the road in, the same view as stop zero from the other direction, the dog asleep, the last motel's drawer holding the last card — a figure inside a wreath, the four corners of the world in the strip's line: a gull, a crab, a dog, a stick figure. He tears the card in half and keeps both halves. A week later he's back in the paper.
